---
name: Adapter request / report
about: Request or report using agent-handover with a specific agent stack
title: "[adapter] "
labels: adapter, good first issue
---

**Agent stack**
Which coding agent? (Codex CLI, Cline, OpenCode, pi, OpenClaw, other)

**How it bootstraps**
Where does it read its rules/config? (e.g. `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, other)

**End-of-session hook**
Can it run a shell command / script when a session ends? How?

**Notes**
Anything specific about how this stack loses context between sessions.
